acquisition.IVR-Online-v3c: integrated variance reduction, sequentially updated posterior
acquisition.PIVOT-KG-Loop-v3c: exact one-step Gaussian KG, sequentially updated posterior
acquisition.Top-Proxy-Online-v3c: descending proxy delta, sequentially updated posterior

contextual_model.model_residual_variance: five-fold held-out MSE minus variance of the calibration mean, floored at 1e-6
contextual_model.observation_variance: mean within-context variance over eight independent calibration rollouts, by response strength and candidate slot
contextual_model.within_round_update: noisy Gaussian conditioning with positive observation variance; coefficient update kept separate

method_definitions.IVR-Online-v3c: two sequential IVR queries under the same contextual calibration
method_definitions.PIVOT-KG-Loop-v3c: two sequential KG queries under contextual calibration
method_definitions.Top-Proxy-Online-v3c: two sequential proxy-ranked queries under the same contextual calibration

primary_estimand: paired five-round cumulative ISR and absolute deployment return under the declared controlled world
query_protocol: two sequential method-specific queries; no common sentinel
terminal_rule: posterior mean over incumbent plus four candidates
